metadata.question: Between September through November 2021, did Seattle experience at least 40cm of rainfall?

data.raw_code: The user is asking about rainfall in Seattle between September-November 2021, specifically if there was at least 40cm of rainfall. For precipitation data, I should use: - NASA's GPM (Global Precipitation Measurement) data: 'NASA/GPM_L3/IMERG_V06' - The precipitation band is 'precipitationCal' (in mm/h) Since the user wants total rainfall in cm over 3 months, I need to: 1. Get daily/monthly precipitation data 2. Sum it over the period (Sep-Nov 2021) 3. Convert from mm to cm (divide by 10) 4. Check if >= 40cm For Seattle location, I'll use a point around downtown Seattle. I should check for: - Empty collection (C1) - No valid pixels after processing (C2) - Invalid calculations (C3) Let me structure this: 1. Use GPM monthly precipitation data 2. Filter for Sep-Nov 2021 3. Sum precipitation and convert to cm 4. Validate and output answer ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const seattle = ee.Geometry.Point([-122.3321, 47.6062]); const startDate = '2021-09-01'; const endDate = '2021-12-01'; // Nov 30 inclusive // 2. Data Acquisition - GPM Monthly Precipitation const gpmCol = ee.ImageCollection('NASA/GPM_L3/IMERG_MONTHLY_V06') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(seattle); const colSize = gpmCol.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Monthly GPM images: ${colSize}`); if (colSize === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Sum precipitation over period const totalPrecip = gpmCol.sum().select('precipitation'); // 4. Calculate total rainfall in cm const stats = totalPrecip.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: seattle.buffer(5000), // 5km buffer around Seattle scale: 10000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const precipMm = stats.get('precipitation').getInfo(); console.log(`Total precipitation (mm): ${precipMm}`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (precipMm === null || precipMm === undefined || isNaN(precipMm)) { console.log("C3"); return; } const precipCm = precipMm / 10; // Convert mm to cm console.log(`Total precipitation (cm): ${precipCm.toFixed(1)}`); if (precipCm >= 40) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
